author: /root/tray_finish

finding.defect: The PowerShell helper is spawned without detached:true. In the installed Node release, libuv adds such children to a Node-held Windows Job with JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE. Abrupt Node termination therefore kills the helper before it can perform its planned parent-loss cleanup.
finding.observed_effect: The retained real Windows parent-loss run found the helper stopped but its exact copied script and session still present.
finding.reason_for_repair: The helper deliberately monitors its parent and stdin so it can remove its own icon and cache after parent loss. Its spawn options prevent that path from running when Windows closes the parent's libuv Job.
finding.precision: The installed Node/libuv version and matching source establish the missing launch option as a concrete defect. This investigation did not instrument AssignProcessToJobObject in the original run, and no new standalone STOP/parent-loss case completed. Actual post-repair Windows behavior remains required.

primary_sources.established: The parent holds the non-inheritable kill-on-close Job; non-detached children join it; detached children skip that assignment. Detached launch does not use CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, so an external enclosing Job can retain containment.
